title: Health Rings and other curios
body:
Items in game 

The Weak Health Ring gives the player 1 extra Heart

The Normal Health Ring gives the player 2 extra Hearts

The Good Health Ring gives the player 3 extra Hearts

There are also potion rings like strength and night vision


Soon there will be different rings, items, a boss or 2, maybe a weapon, and maybe 3D armor set

Some commands- /Health_add #- (changes base health. 2 health is one heart) but can't go under 20

EX: /health_add 24 = 12 hearts

/health_add 100 = 50 hearts

/health_reset- this command resets a players health to default

/heal- heals a player
